summary.text: Brian Lockwood is the Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 61 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Tina McKinnor (D).
A Los Angeles native who works in finance and property management, he is communications director of the Republican Party of Los Angeles County.

paragraphs.text: In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Brian Lockwood described himself as a Catholic, sixth-generation Angeleno who is married and raising two sons.

He said that in addition to work in finance and property management he is a past Grand Knight of Knights of Columbus Council 3744, a former director on the Neighborhood Council of Westchester/Playa, and communications director of the Republican Party of Los Angeles County.
Lockwood said his priorities are enforcing the law, including against violent crime, homelessness and drug activity on streets; reducing taxes and regulations; and improving infrastructure.
He named law enforcement and fraud prevention as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
